description: PeopleFlow discloses QueueNorth, AssistWorks, ArchiveLane on the contractual subprocessor list (or ceases routing CloudScale Dynamics data through them) and confirms no other undisclosed subprocessors exist.
owner: PeopleFlow Vendor Manager / CloudScale Chief People Officer
evidence_of_closure: Updated, countersigned subprocessor list matching telemetry-observed processors; written confirmation of completeness.
fail_closed_action: Suspend data transmission to any subprocessor not on the disclosed list.

description: PeopleFlow provides a corrected data-residency statement reflecting actual processing regions (Philippines, eu-west-1), or relocates processing to match the us-east-1-exclusive claim.
evidence_of_closure: Signed data-flow map matching telemetry; or telemetry re-export showing all regions collapsed to us-east-1.
fail_closed_action: Treat LOC-02 as false for contractual purposes; apply cross-border transfer terms to all affected data classes until corrected.

description: HelpSphere (tier-1 support, ticket/attachment access) provides an independent assurance report (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent) and enables session recording for privileged support access to attachments.
evidence_of_closure: Independent assurance report + configuration export showing session recording enabled.
fail_closed_action: Restrict HelpSphere from attachment access until assurance is provided.

description: PeopleFlow enforces MFA on all privileged support access; retroactively investigates the PA-002 non-MFA session(s) for unauthorized activity.
evidence_of_closure: MFA enforcement policy export + investigation summary for PA-002.
fail_closed_action: Suspend the affected actor's privileged access pending investigation.

description: PeopleFlow explains and remediates the broken privileged-access hash chain (integrity of the audit log itself), and re-exports a verifiably unbroken log for the affected period.
evidence_of_closure: Re-exported, independently hash-verified access log covering the gap period.
fail_closed_action: Treat the access log as unverifiable for the affected period; do not rely on it for LOG-07 evidence until remediated.

description: PeopleFlow corrects deletion-job status reporting to fire only after the completion event, and supplies backup-purge evidence (timestamp + verification) for every deletion job, including DEL-710.
evidence_of_closure: Corrected deletion pipeline export; backup_purge_at populated and verifiable for all sampled jobs.
fail_closed_action: Treat DEL-05 as unproven; escalate to legal if termination deletion is contractually represented as complete before evidence exists.

description: DPA is amended so the 72-hour notice clock starts at vendor discovery/should-have-discovered, not solely at vendor confirmation, and PeopleFlow commits to an interim notice within 24h of any suspected incident.
fail_closed_action: Escalate any suspected incident internally at CloudScale on independent detection, without waiting on PeopleFlow confirmation.

description: PeopleFlow remediates the EX-CC7.2 alert-review gap (7 of 40 days missing evidence) and demonstrates a full review cycle with retained evidence for one subsequent audit period.
evidence_of_closure: Bridge letter or interim testing evidence for the remediation period.
fail_closed_action: Do not rely on LOG-07 as met until remediation evidence exists.

description: PeopleFlow supplies a termination-access export (IAM-04) so the 24-hour de-provisioning claim can be tested against evidence rather than accepted on questionnaire text alone.
evidence_of_closure: Termination-access log export covering at least one full quarter.
fail_closed_action: Treat IAM-04 as unverified; do not represent it as tested in any downstream audit.

description: Even after all conditions close, PeopleFlow remains a single vendor with access to regulated PII (bank details, tax IDs) and no customer-side ability to independently detect an incident before PeopleFlow chooses to confirm one.
Historical processing that already occurred in undisclosed regions/subprocessors cannot be un-processed; conditions govern going-forward state only.
SOC 2 Type II carve-out method means subservice organisations' controls are not directly tested by PeopleFlow's own auditor.
